criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: There are nine separate pictures in LOOK V2 colour, and the measured frames show no grey middle (preflight: grey_mid 0.001, 0.003 and 0.02, vivid 0.76 to 0.89). Strongest frames: 5 (stacks of 3 and 8 reams on oak, ratio err 0, contact shadows, torn top ream) and 9 (a large stack with the envelope, the letter's accent line and a pen under a window-muntin shadow, type on the left inside the shadow). Frame 8 is a clear 6 by 5 count of 30 with the gold tab on cubby 30's rail. Frame 1's rack holds the cover. The weak frames pull the score down. Frame 7 was planned as the showstopper and reads at feed size as a blurred striped column over a magenta and peach band, with no legible reams. Its shadow does not visibly cross the highlighted line, which sits in the violet-lit part of the page. Frame 2's top 45 percent is plain violet wash under the type. The planned office wall and window are missing, so it is a headline over a drawing, and the walnut has motion-streak grain. In frame 6 the eye goes to the two flags, their cast shadows and the wall seal, not to the piles. The 2027 pile reads as a flat box, and the dek sits on a muddy band over the seating. Frame 3's floor is a hard corrugated stripe that looks aliased, and the dek covers the Register page planned on the mat. Frame 4's relief reads, but the 'binder clip' is two rounded wire loops, the oak blotter is a flat red slab, and the greeking is blackletter noise. On the slide bar that is two 8s, two 7.5s, two 7s and three frames at about 6. That matches the 7 descriptor ('one frame leans on a default') with more than one soft frame, so not higher.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The spine holds across the contact sheet: Fraunces hook, Manrope dek, mono furniture, counter, claim ids and site line on every frame, all in the violet-to-rose watch palette. The accent mostly means one thing: the clipped line (1), the highlight and seals (4), the highlighted line (7), the tab (8) and the letter line (9). The story runs in order, and the paper motif carries 1, 5, 6, 7 and 9. The material code drifts, though. The kraft reams render tan on 1, peach-pink on 5 (close to the dusk gold accent under the warm grade) and olive on 9, so 'kraft equals the estimate' is not one material. Gold flag fringe on 6 brushes the accent's hue.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Not my lens. Every slide numeral in copy.json is a claim figure ($1,947,310,000, $4,286,040,000, $507,450,000, $1,116,890,000, 1987, 30, the dates). The S5 stack ratio is measured at 2.2013 against a truth of 2.2013, err 0. Slide 2 pairs the kicker 'Since 1987' with the proposal's new definition, which hints at a 1987 definition the dek correctly does not claim. The caption's Eckhardt sentence cites no claim id in storyboard.md, so the integrity judge should trace it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Names the decider (Comptroller Don Huffines), the instrument (Rule 3.308, Texas Register November 20th), the money both statewide and local, the deadline (December 20th) and the contact (Robin Robinson and the address on 9). 'It is still only a proposal' is honest. Local governments are general and no Texas city or transit authority is named, so one stake is stated generally.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover question pays on 2. The turn comes at 5 to 7 (the estimate, then 'insignificant' in the same note), and 8 to 9 close on action. Frames 3 and 4 both define the exclusion and overlap. Frame 6 restates frame 5's mechanic at a smaller scale and could fold into it.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, plain and on house rules. 'Customer data in, organized data back' and 'It is still only a proposal' are good lines, and 'drawn to illustrate' appears once (S3). Little Texas texture: no place, city or transit system is named anywhere, so it reads correct but statewide-generic.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Racks, a data hall, reams, a dais and a Register page all differ from Nov 24 to 26 (art_plan.json). Type sits in five distinct places. Two moves are familiar: card files in a sorter on 8 echo the Nov 25 tabbed-card tray, and the server rack and data hall are this product's recurring AI default.

named_defects: S7 (planned showstopper): the out-of-focus stack is unreadable as reams, the shadow does not visibly cross the gold line, and a large magenta/peach mid band dominates
S2: top 45 percent is a plain violet wash, the planned office and window are absent, and the walnut grain looks like motion blur
S6: flags, flag shadows and wall seal steal the focal from the two piles; the 2027 pile reads as a flat box; the dek sits on a muddy band
S3: aliased-looking striped floor; the dek covers the planned Register page on the mat
S4: the 'binder clip' is two wire loops; the oak blotter is a flat red slab; blackletter-noise greeking
Kraft ream albedo drifts between S1 (tan), S5 (peach, near the accent hue) and S9 (olive)
S7 machine QA warn: hook and dek run 16 px past the 80 px right safe margin (486 + 530 = 1016)
one_sentence_fix: Rebuild S7 as the showstopper it was planned to be: stop the aperture down so the fiscal 2032 stack keeps countable kraft reams and a torn top, drop the key to about 8 degrees so its violet shadow visibly crosses the dusk gold line, and replace the magenta and peach backdrop with the oak desk and room from S9's world.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The planned showstopper reads at 432 px as a blurred striped column above a magenta and peach band. The reams are illegible and the stack's shadow misses the highlighted line, so the image does not set 'insignificant' against the figure.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Narrow the depth-of-field blur so the stack's ream wrappers and torn top read, lower the coral key to about 8 degrees and aim it so the stack's shadow falls diagonally across the gold highlight, and seat both on a lit oak surface instead of the flat magenta field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The top 45 percent is an empty violet gradient holding only type. The office wall and window in the storyboard were never built, so the frame is a headline over a tabletop drawing, and the counter grain is streaky motion blur.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera to counter height and build the office wall with a lit window behind the bound report, so the type sits in the window's quiet. Replace the streak texture with real walnut figure under a raking window key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The flags, their large cast shadows and the wall seal own the frame. The two local-loss piles, the planned focal, sit small in the bottom third, the 2027 pile reads as a flat box, and the dek lies on a muddy band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the camera in and down to the dais ledge so the two piles fill the lower half with ream wrappers and sheet edges visible. Crop the flags to the frame edges, soften their shadows, and seat the dek on the lit dais front rather than the dark seating.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The perforated floor renders as a hard corrugated stripe that reads as aliasing, and the dek covers the Register page planned at the rack's foot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swap the striped floor for perforated tiles with a seam grid and a scuffed coral-lit path, and lift the dek block up onto the dark lower rack door so the page on the mat is visible below it.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The 'chrome binder clip' is modelled as two rounded wire loops, the oak blotter is a flat red slab with no grain, and the greeked columns read as blackletter noise.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model a real binder clip (a black or chrome steel jaw with folded wire handles) at its 12 mm height, give the blotter oak grain at measured height under the chassis key, and greek the text as thin violet-grey bars like S7's page.
